questions.question: King Solomon's older brother Adonijah asked Bathsheba to speak to the king for him. What did he want?

answers.text: Abishag the Shunammite as his wife
Command over the king's whole army
A city of his own to rule over

questions.question: After Adonijah was put to death, the army commander Joab ran away from King Solomon. Where did he go?

answers.text: To the tent of the LORD

questions.question: After Joab was killed, who did King Solomon put over the army in his place?
King Solomon told Shimei to stay in Jerusalem. What would happen on the day Shimei crossed the Kidron Valley?

answers.text: He would be put in chains
